$comment: The Docker-gated test groups: one docker matrix entry in .github/workflows/ci.yml and one root `test:docker:<group>` script each. `runs` lists, per working directory, the test files (a `*` matches within one path segment) that the group's script runs there; `required` lists full test titles that must pass in that group (scripts/ci/skip-guard.py). `exempt` names the Docker-gated test files that never pass in CI by design (a live key or the public web), with the reason; they need no group but may sit in one. `maxSkips` bounds the skipped tests in a group's log to the by-design skips that `maxSkipsWhy` names, so a test that newly skips fails the guard. packages/e2e/src/ci-guard.test.ts checks that every Docker-gated test file is in exactly one group, that the scripts run exactly these files, and that each required title is defined in one of its group's files.

exempt.packages/harness-pi/src/pi-ext-live.test: needs the agent image (PTREE_E2E_IMAGE) and POMTREED_PI_PROVIDER set to a provider name; it writes a throwaway placeholder credential and makes no model call, so it needs no live key. Exempt only because no CI group sets POMTREED_PI_PROVIDER yet; running it in a group is a ledgered follow-up
exempt.packages/e2e/src/docker-pi.test.ts: needs a live model key; runs in e2e-lifecycle, where it skips (counted in maxSkips)
tests the gate's own logic and the engine-profile transport with scripted engine answers and recording stubs, so it needs no Docker or Podman and runs in the normal lite suite; it imports docker-gate.ts only for those pure functions, which is what makes the guard count it as Docker-gated
tests the gate helpers (runtimeSkip, the engine-threading CLI wrappers, the recorded engine samples and the gated-suite drift guard) with scripted engines and recording stubs, so it needs no Docker or Podman and runs in the normal lite suite; it imports docker-gate.ts only for those pure functions, which is what makes the guard count it as Docker-gated
exempt.packages/sandbox-docker/src/browser-real: its one test needs the public web (PTREE_NET_TESTS); runs in sandbox, where it skips (counted in maxSkips)

sandbox.maxSkipsWhy: gVisor (no runsc on the runner), the NET-gated real-article capture, the agent-net Docker Desktop test (non-Linux only), and the three NET-gated browser smoke tests
required: Docker network-none worker lifecycle uses the packaged bridge and nonroot identity
Docker wait captures OOM state before cleanup
real Docker confines TCP/IPv6/DNS/UDP and socket mutation; scoped relay and Node proxy env still work
audited-public Docker: public HTTP/HTTPS fetch is allowed and audited; metadata, private and host aliases are denied and audited; no direct route
browser worker: page script is denied and audited at a relay authority that Pi's own call still reaches
Docker result collection uses the actual workspace and base environment
container reaches a gateway-bound listener (fails on a host firewall that blocks docker0) but never a loopback-bound one
cli scenario 1: happy path spawn, tool, result, wait, reap; spend is the sum of settlements
cli operator CUS-7: pomtree kill of a parent cancels its sleeping child within grace plus kill, the container is gone, no orphan-cancel-error

e2e-lifecycle.maxSkipsWhy: the two NET-gated browser-live harness tests and docker-pi (needs a live model key)
required: real Docker, no model: scripted root spawns two children, waits, reaps, reports
cli lifecycle REC-8: drain refuses the next spawn, the busy agent's container survives the SIGTERM restart, is adopted and finishes once
